title: The Devil in the White City
author: Erik Larson
summary: Erik Larson alternates between two stories of Chicago in 1893: architect Daniel Burnham's effort to build the World's Fair, and Dr H. H. Holmes, a serial killer preying on visitors.
readIf: you like narrative history that sets ambition and murder side by side.
skipIf: you want a pure crime story, since half the book covers architecture and planning.
